outcome: Connect the scheduler to the running system: a control mode that sets a concurrency limit, and a queue summary that reports allocation, waiting reason and exhaustion, so shared resource allocation becomes observable.
non_goals: Do not re-design the scheduler's decision rules here
Do not report an allocation the scheduler did not decide
Do not let a limit change retroactively invalidate a granted claim

transitions.reason: the M5 dogfood design measured that nine of the twelve declared capabilities cannot be exercised and that five of them have no implementation at all; this task owns escalation E22-5, where internal/scheduler is imported by no package outside itself, no control mode sets a concurrency limit, and the queue summary reports no allocation, waiting reason or exhaustion, so the declared capability cannot be observed

the five surface tasks were each designed to widen the same six files (the api handler, the application ports, service and read models, the openapi document, the owner console and both stores), so they cannot run at once: three concurrent writers to one file leave the coordinator resolving a textual conflict by hand, and an evidence key measured on a tree that never becomes a commit is the defect that ev-v2-013-infra-plan already recorded. They are serialised, each branching from the tip the previous one landed on
every task this one depends on is complete, so the block has cleared
